scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && bundle exec rails server -p 3001
scripts.test: pnpm test:web && pnpm db:prepare:test && pnpm test:api
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && bundle exec rails test
scripts.db:prepare: cd apps/api && bundle exec rails db:prepare
scripts.db:prepare:test: cd apps/api && RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rails db:prepare
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && bundle exec rails db:migrate
